_comment: Editorial content for PPL. Every fact here is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached: no licence-cleared photograph of a PPL field exists on the open licence sources, and a generic rig photo would imply it is theirs. Add imagePath/imageSource/imageLicence together when a real one is available.
description: Pakistan Petroleum Limited is engaged in exploration, prospecting, development and production of oil, natural gas and mineral resources. At 30 June 2025 it reported 21 producing fields — nine operated and twelve partner-operated — and 46 exploratory blocks (excluding blocks relinquished or provisionally awarded), with its share of national output at about 19% of local gas production and about 16% of local oil production. Its associated company Pakistan Minerals (Pvt) Limited holds an indirect 25% non-operating share in the Reko Diq copper and gold project.
